shared: All three coat oozes in moss layers that pile up and turn into stats later.
differ: When the moss pays off: as you sell, as it lingers, or when a fight starts.

takes.label: Every sale counts
takes.line: Moss spreads across the whole board, and each sale decides where it goes, so selling is the puzzle every turn.
takes.look_if: to plan every sale and grow the board as one.

takes.label: Moss that stays
takes.line: Moss stays behind when you sell an ooze, so cheap oozes become a steady snowball you can read at a glance.
takes.look_if: a clean, steady snowball that is easy to read.

takes.label: The fight-start choir
takes.line: A choir sings moss onto the board at the start of each fight, so the big moments happen in combat.
takes.look_if: big moments at the start of every fight.
